history.text: Several territorial versions were abandoned after promotions left the NWA to join the AWA, which recognized its own title in those territories.
The WWF split from the NWA, leaving only the JCP version active within the NWA, still controlled by JCP.
The JCP championship was renamed the WCW World Tag Team Championship after WCW split from the NWA.
The NWA and WCW held a tournament, won by Terry Gordy and Steve Williams, to crown the first officially recognized NWA champions.
The NWA withdrew its recognition of the WCW-controlled championship after severing ties with WCW.
The NWA held a one-night tournament in Dallas, won by The Rock 'n' Roll Express, to fill the vacant title.
The NWA allowed the WWF to control the championship during the Invasion storyline, ending with the title returning to independent control by 1999.
NWA-TNA gained control of the championship and crowned A.J. Styles and Jerry Lynn as its first champions.
The NWA withdrew recognition of NWA-TNA, which created the separate TNA World Tag Team Championship.
The NWA held a three-team tournament after the split from TNA, won by The Real American Heroes.
The vacated championship was awarded at the Crockett Cup tournament, won by Villain Enterprises.
